resolution.note: krn task comment appends signed entries to tasks/<id>.comments.jsonl (merge=union)

title: Add comments to krn task
body:
Operator 2026-10-28 granted an exception to the D23 tracker freeze: krn task gets comments, the main gap versus Beads. Comments keep decision history beside the task instead of only in PRs.
Acceptance: krn task comment ID --body-file appends a signed, dated entry stored canonically with the task (or beside it), shown by krn task show, validated by krn task check, mergeable across worktrees without silent loss; workers may comment but never change status.
